top_5_fixes.fix: DENSIFY THE LAYOUT: Replace the empty canvas with a proper 12-column CSS Grid containing: (Row 1) 4x KPI cards (Revenue $128.4K, Expenses, Profit Margin %, Active Customers) each with sparklines; (Row 2) 66% Area Chart (Revenue Over Time) + 33% Recent Transactions table (5 rows); (Row 3) Secondary widgets. This alone moves from wireframe to product.

FIX COLOR SYSTEM: Abandon the black-sidebar-vs-white-canvas split. Use unified light theme: Background #f8fafc, Cards #ffffff with border #e2e8f0 and shadow-sm, Primary action #2563eb (blue) or keep #059669 (emerald) but desaturated, Text #0f172a/#64748b. Remove the heavy dark block entirely or convert to a 60px icon-rail sidebar.

ADD TYPOGRAPHIC HIERARCHY: Implement Inter/SF Pro with strict scale—Page H1: 24px Bold (#0f172a), Metric Value: 36px Bold/Tabular (#0f172a), Metric Label: 13px Medium (#64748b), Body: 14px Regular (#334155), Table Header: 12px Uppercase Medium (#94a3b8). Left-align all data.

COMPONENT POLISH PASS: Add 12px border-radius to all cards, 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05) shadows, 1px #e2e8f0 borders. Ensure buttons have 8px padding, 6px radius, clear primary (filled) vs secondary (outlined) states. Add hover states (background color shift) to interactive elements.

ADD APPLICATION CHROME: Top navigation bar (64px, white, border-bottom, logo left, search center, avatar right), Breadcrumb row below nav, User menu dropdown, Date range selector (pill shape, border, calendar icon). This frames the dashboard as a real SaaS app, not a Dribbble shot.
